title: Most Generic non personal advice
body: This app says it try’s to build your AI around you, to give you specific help for your ADHD but it doesn’t every time I have tried it, it always gives me the same most generic advice that was probably the first result on a google search. An example of this is, I told my AI 8 times to not use timers because they make me more anxious instead of helping me focus for that set time but after I had to tell it not to do that for the 8th time and it apologized and told me it wouldn’t use timers again. Then proceeded to turn on a timer 5 minutes later in the same chat

author: Liwar1624

title: I don’t actually know what this app does
body:
This app did exactly what I saw a multilevel marketing company do.
This app did exactly what I saw a timeshare company do.

What is it? 
It relies on the sunk cost fallacy, making you fill out answers for all of 10 minutes, sign up, etc, but then before the app has done anything other than ask you a bunch of questions on what could literally be a quizlet form, BAM 💥 unskippable paywall.

Don’t worry though, because the paywall assures you that this uses research from all the big universities that do research.
And that people reviewed it really highly and that it helped them very much.

Give us money. Guarantee results AFTER 30 days.
30 day automatic billing.

Truth be told I don’t even actually know what this app does. Other than the Quizlet forms… I haven’t seen a single second of functionality from the app.
Is it games? Is it short videos? Is it an AI Chatbot? Is it a soothing meditation generator? I have no clue there’s a paywall.


And don’t get me wrong I am more than happy to pay for an app.
But before I’m willing to give out my money, I wanna have some semblance of an idea of what the app is actually offering.

I get that running an AI thing is expensive. The API cost alone.
But you know what isn’t expensive?
Developers screen recording a video of their app, actually working, and putting that in the tutorial process so you can see what their app is actually about.



So here it is. My two star review.
Two and not one because when you sort reviews, the most critical ones are always two stars with reason and not just a strong emotion.

Even if you just made the first day free. Even if you just filmed a video. Even if you just showed us the user interface and greyed everything out so that we can’t use it.
